suggested_change: Criterion 1 should accept 'no new information' as valid evidence if call summary is complete and reviewed; Criterion 3 should fail the evaluator for incomplete input rather than penalize the agent; Criterion 4 should clarify whether 'vague language' in next steps applies only when component score is 6 or below, not 7+; Criterion 5 should not penalize Unknown (1/10) Champion on early-stage deals—reframe as 'Champion unknown expected within N calls, flag only if threshold exceeded.'
